title: Ulyana and the Clock
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Felix Montrose, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
